## Grip Impedance and the Guitar Analogy {#sec-impact-grip-impedance}

A loosely resting finger on a guitar string can absorb energy, alter a boundary,
and suppress modes that have motion at the finger location. Touching near a node
can instead leave selected harmonics relatively intact. The useful analogy is
**mode-dependent coupling to a dissipative contact**, not a rule that a looser
golf grip always sounds worse or a tighter grip always sounds better.

A club is a distributed shaft joined to a complex head. A hand near the grip may
strongly affect low shaft modes but weakly affect a localized face or crown mode.
It can alter damping, effective inertia, stiffness, contact area, and slipping
simultaneously. A clubhead is also not an ideal string: bending, torsion, shell
motion and acoustic radiation have different spatial patterns.

For a stationary support, represent the linearized grip by a driving-point
mechanical impedance $\mathbf Z_g(\omega)$ relating the wrench into the
boundary to the velocity at its port. A matrix is needed for translations, rotations and their coupling.

The [AffineDrift epic](https://github.com/D-sorganization/AffineDrift/issues/4253)
owns theory and evidence. The
[Tools epic](https://github.com/D-sorganization/Tools/issues/5068) owns reusable

existing test coverage are recorded in the linked inventory; a new solver must
integrate with these capabilities rather than duplicate them.

| Tier | Retained Physics | What It Can Establish |
|---|---|---|
| R0 | Detached rigid bodies, full inertia, instantaneous normal impulse | Analytic limits, frame conventions and impulse accounting |
| R1 | Existing lumped ball–head–hands chain | Sensitivity within its one-dimensional, initially relaxed assumptions |
| R2 | Distributed loaded shaft, head inertia, grip impedance | Local shaft response, preload, modal phase and torque transmission |

review_metadata.reviewer: codex-technical-review-20261003-glossary; #4839 full 72-entry review

finding_summaries.rationale: Drift is the complete zero-declared-input field, including retained states and compatible constraints. Control-affinity is pointwise at fixed state and settings; it does not make trajectories additive or identify biological passivity. Input level, internal state and frozen parameters must be declared. The ZTCF family retains pointwise, stitched, forward and branched constructions; only the latter two integrate the dynamics.

DCR uses bounded control capacity in one acceleration space and metric, with a reported regularizer. It can exceed one and is not a fraction of motion or physiological effort. Local authority, finite-horizon reachability, constraint-compatible velocity and task-preserving velocity are distinct. Underactuation uses the reduced mechanical input-map rank; state dimension need not be 2n. Coordinates may be local or redundant, with explicit constraints.

Generalized forces are virtual-work coefficients. Constraint multipliers require the transpose-Jacobian map and declared constraint scaling. Workless total reactions can exchange power between subsystems; moving constraints and friction require separate treatment. Forward dynamics solves the complete declared model. Inverse dynamics and net joint moments do not uniquely identify muscle forces or unmeasured contacts.

Angular momentum includes translation about the chosen origin; inertia depends on reference point and axis. Distinguish force and couple work, kinetic and potential energy, and applied loads already represented in a potential. Smash factor is a speed ratio, with mass-weighted squared speed entering a translational-energy ratio. Clubhead speed requires a declared tracked point. COR uses relative normal contact velocity; impulse and duration yield mean rather than peak force. Compression ratings and COP have protocol/contact assumptions.

Wrist coaching labels do not uniquely define anatomical coordinates or a three-dimensional club release. Forearm pronation/supination is separated from wrist motion and global palm direction. Proximal speed-peak order does not identify torque order or energy flow. Feedforward and feedback can coexist; ideomotor and motor-program accounts do not establish one identified neural implementation of a golf swing.

Governance, provenance, protection and qualification describe declared processes and evidence scope. A hash, review label or named model alone does not establish scientific truth. Aerodynamic definitions use air-relative velocity and conditional force directions; launch angle uses a declared horizontal plane.

Regenerate the glossary from canonical YAML, verify exact freshness, use a valid tooltip key and assert corrected plain definitions. Fence the alphabetical index as raw HTML so its 21 links render as navigation rather than a code block. Freshness and navigation regressions failed before the corrections and passed afterward.

Move seven long formulas to existing display-math containers so mobile readers can scroll them without page overflow. Correct the inertia integral mass differential. Four bounded browser cells pass; selected screenshots and a scroll-through inspect 157 math containers with no error/lazy placeholders. This is not whole-site or exhaustive screen-reader acceptance.
